Subject: Internal: Zenith AI — SLA reconciliation and proposed credit (need approval)

Team — forwarding the customer request for formal SLA compensation from Zenith AI (see thread below). Key facts:
- Incident 2026-11-12 02:14–03:48 UTC — total service interruption window identified in postmortem as 1 hour 34 minutes (94 minutes).
- Customer committed monthly spend: $45,000 (provided by Alex).
- Contract SLO: 99.9% monthly uptime (Appendix B).

I ran the standard reconciliation:
- Minutes in November (we're using a 30-day month for contract simplicity): 43,200 minutes.
- Downtime minutes: 94.
- Measured uptime = (43,200 - 94) / 43,200 = 0.997829 ≈ 99.7829%

Redwood credit policy (per contract banding):
- >=99.9%: no credit
- 99.0% to <99.9%: 10% of monthly fee
- <99.0%: 25% of monthly fee

Under that policy, Zenith falls into the 99.0%–<99.9% band — proposed credit = 10% of monthly fee = $4,500.

Attached: sla-credit-calculation-zenithai.xlsx (worksheet shows calculations + per-minute reconciliation) and postmortem PDF.

Requesting: Marcus (Billing) — please confirm approval to issue a 10% credit and whether we should (a) post an invoice line item for Nov, or (b) issue a one-time credit token that the customer can apply. Naomi — can you flag any contract/legal considerations? Sean — FYI for executive visibility; customer asked for ETA before Nov 20 billing run.

Thanks,
— Hannah
